blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Flow matching has emerged as a scalable paradigm for training high-quality generative models, but sampling from the learned probability flow requires many network evaluations. Distillation can reduce this cost to one or a few evaluations; however, one-step generation often sacrifices quality, making few-step generation the practical operating regime. Existing few-step methods perform their iterative computation along the probability flow and therefore require a fixed, manually chosen timestep discretization. This discretization is often chosen heuristically and is expensive to tune; it may also be restrictive when refinement difficulty differs across samples or spatial locations. We introduce data-space iteration, a few-step generation framework that removes flow discretization altogether. Starting from noise, a shared generator directly refines its prediction in data space, with every iteration trained to produce the best sample permitted by its capacity. Our formulation integrates with distribution matching distillation (DMD) with minimal changes, enabling a controlled comparison between iteration methods under matched training settings. On class-conditional ImageNet 256x256, data-space iteration outperforms standard discretization baselines and matches or improves upon variants selected through schedule search, without requiring schedule-specific training. These results show that data-space iteration provides a simple and effective alternative to discretized flow-space iteration for fast generation.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Flow matching ( Lipman et al., 2023 ) has become a scalable pretraining paradigm for modern generative models. By learning a continuous probability flow between simple noise and the data distribution, it provides a stable and flexible foundation for high-capacity image and video generators ( Seawead et al., 2025 ; Seedance et al., 2025 ; Seedance et al., 2026 ) . However, this strength comes with an inference-time cost: producing a high-quality sample requires numerically integrating the learned flow, often with many network evaluations. This cost has motivated a broad line of distillation methods that convert a pretrained flow-matching model into a generator that can sample in one or only a few steps ( Salimans and Ho, 2022 ; Song et al., 2023 ; Frans et al., 2025 ; Geng et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 流量相配(Lipman等,2023年)已经成为现代基因模型可伸缩的先行训练范式. 通过学习简单的噪声和数据分布之间的连续概率流,它为高功率图像和视频生成器提供了稳定而灵活的基础(Seawead等,2025;Seedance等,2025;Seedance等,2026). 然而,这种实力伴随着推论时间的成本:制作出高质量的样本需要从数字上整合所学到的流量,往往有许多网络评价. 这一成本激发出一行广泛的蒸馏方法,将经过预先训练的流相匹配模型转换为能够分一步或仅几步取样的发电机(Salimans and Ho, 2022; Song等人, 2023; Frans等人, 2025; Geng等人, 2025)。

blocks.en: In principle, distillation can aim for one-step generation. In practice, however, a single network evaluation provides limited effective computational depth, and aggressive one-step distillation often leads to visible quality degradation ( Lin et al., 2025a ) . Few-step generation has therefore become the more practical operating point, trading a small number of additional evaluations for substantially improved sample quality. This is also the regime most relevant to deployed high-resolution generative systems, where four-step sampling is commonly used as a favorable balance between latency and fidelity ( Zheng et al., 2026b ) .
blocks.zh: 原则上,蒸馏可以瞄准一步生成. 但在实践中,单一网络评价提供的有效计算深度有限,积极的一步分馏往往导致明显的质量退化(Lin等,2025a)。 。 。 。 。 因此,很少分步生成成为更切合实际的操作点,而是用少数额外评价来大幅提高抽样质量。 这也是与部署的高分辨率基因系统最相关的制度,其中四步采样通常被用为成熟性和忠诚之间的有利平衡(郑等,2026b.).

blocks.en: Despite this progress, existing few-step generators still perform their iterative computation in probability-flow space. Whether the method denoises and then renoises to the next noise level, or directly learns maps between intermediate flow marginals, generation is organized around a manually chosen discretization of the flow-time interval. This discretization is usually treated as a fixed design choice rather than a learned component of the generator.

blocks.en: The fixed discretization is especially limiting for modern distillation procedures based on self-rollout backward distillation ( Yin et al., 2024a ; Kohler et al., 2024 ) . In these methods, each generator update is trained on states produced by the generator’s own preceding rollout steps. The rollout schedule must therefore be defined during training, not merely selected at inference time. In applications such as causal streaming video generation, self-rollout is even more central because the model must learn to refine its own generated history ( Lin et al., 2025b ; Huang et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2026a ) . Yet the timestep discretization used for rollout is typically chosen heuristically ( Hoogeboom et al., 2023 ; Esser et al., 2024 ) . Searching over alternative schedules is expensive because each candidate schedule can require training a different distilled generator.
blocks.zh: 固定盘片化对基于自滚后向蒸馏的现代蒸馏程序特别有限制(Yin等人,2024a; Kohler等, 2024 (英语). 在这些方法中,每个发电机的更新都经过关于发电机自己在推出前步骤产生的状态的培训。 因此,在培训期间必须确定推出时间表,而不仅仅是在推断时选择。 在因果流出视频生成等应用中,自我推出更为重要,因为模型必须学会完善自身的生成历史(Lin等,2025b; 黄等,2025;郑等,2026a.). 然而,用于推出的时间步盘化通常选取高压(Hoogeboom等,2023;Esser等,2024)。 搜索替代时间表费用高昂,因为每个候选时间表都可能需要培训不同的蒸馏发电机。

blocks.en: One intuition motivating our formulation is that there may not be a universal best timestep discretization. The difficulty of a denoising transition could depend on the sample being generated: different prompts or classes can induce samples with different semantic and spectral complexity and might therefore favor different effective step sizes. Likewise, spatial regions with different frequency content might benefit from different forms of refinement. A single global flow timestep nevertheless advances every sample and location through the same denoising schedule. This observation motivates investigating whether refinement can be organized without a fixed probability-flow discretization.
blocks.zh: 我们提出的一种直觉是,可能没有普遍的最佳时间步盘。 消音转换的难度可能取决于生成的样本:不同的提示或分级可以诱导具有不同语义和光谱复杂性的样本,因此可能倾向于不同的有效步骤尺寸. 同样,不同频率内容的空间区域可能受益于不同形式的改进。 然而,单一的全球流动时间步通过同样的取消通知时间表,推进每个样本和地点。 这种观察促使人们调查能否在没有固定概率-流盘化的情况下组织完善.

blocks.en: We propose data-space iteration for few-step generation. Instead of repeatedly moving along a discretized probability-flow path, our generator performs all refinement directly in data space. Starting from an initial noise sample, the generator repeatedly updates the current data-space prediction. Every refinement step is trained to output the best sample it can, given the current estimate and the original noise. This formulation removes the timestep-discretization hyperparameter from the generator’s iterative sampling process and lets the model spend all of its computation on directly improving the sample.
blocks.zh: 我们提出数据空间迭代 几步生成。 我们的生成器不重复沿着一个盘状概率-流量路径移动,而是直接在数据空间中进行所有改进。 从初始噪声样本开始,生成器反复更新了当前的数据空间预测. 考虑到目前的估计和最初的噪音,每个改进步骤都经过培训,能够输出出最好的样本。 这种配方可以从生成器的迭代采样过程中去掉分出分出时间步的超参数,让模型将其全部的计算都花在直接改进取样上.

blocks.en: Our method can be trained with almost no modification to the widely used distribution matching distillation (DMD) framework ( Yin et al., 2024b ; Yin et al., 2024a ) . The real and fake flow models, the DMD objective, and the self-rollout training structure are retained; only the generator rollout is changed from probability-flow iteration to data-space iteration. This makes the comparison especially controlled: the training recipe is held fixed while the iterative sampling space is changed.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法可以在对广泛使用的分布相配蒸馏(DMD)框架(Yin等,2024b)几乎没有修改的情况下加以培训; Yin等, 2024a) (中文(中国大陆) ). 真实和假的流量模型, DMD 目标,以及自滚出训练结构被保留;只有生成器的推出被从概率-流量迭代改为数据-空间迭代. 这使得比较特别受控制:在改变迭代采样空间的同时,训练食谱被固定.

blocks.en: We evaluate on class-conditional ImageNet 256 × 256 256\times 256 generation ( Russakovsky et al., 2015 ) , using a pretrained SiT-XL/2 ( Ma et al., 2024 ) flow-matching teacher backbone. Across matched DMD training settings, data-space iteration outperforms standard discretization baselines and matches or improves upon variants selected through schedule search. These results suggest that removing manually specified flow-time discretization can retain or improve generation quality while eliminating the need to train schedule-specific generators.
blocks.zh: 我们用预训的SiT-XL/2(Ma等,2024年)流配师骨干来评价阶级条件的ImageNet 256×256\times 256代(Russakovsky等,2015年). 在整个匹配的DMD培训设置中,数据空间迭接比标准光碟化基线超标,并匹配或改进通过时间表搜索选定的变体。 这些结果表明,移除手动指定的流程时盘式可以保留或提高生成质量,同时消除培训特定时刻表发电机的需要.

blocks.en: Note that this self-rollout strategy is already standard in DMD-based few-step generators. We change only the rollout process: existing methods iterate along the probability flow, whereas our method iterates in data space. blocks.en: Some prior DMD-based methods add auxiliary adversarial (GAN) losses ( Goodfellow et al., 2014 ) or rectified-flow objectives ( Liu et al., 2023 ) . We omit these components because they introduce extra loss weights and design choices, expanding the search space and making it harder to isolate the effect of the iteration method. Our goal is not to combine every available technique in pursuit of state-of-the-art performance, but to provide a simple, controlled, and reproducible setting for comparing iterative sampling methods.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 1(a) , the DMD timestep weighting can influence the resulting FID. We first search over loss-weighting functions w ⁡ ( τ ) w(\tau) under uniform timestep sampling and find that performance is best when training places greater emphasis on high-noise timesteps. blocks.en: Table 3 reports the main results and addresses two distinct comparisons. Our primary comparison uses the uniform discretization adopted by prior few-step methods. This represents the standard setting in which a practitioner selects a reasonable schedule without training multiple schedule-specific generators. We additionally report the best result from our discretization search as an oracle-style comparison. In the self-rollout setting, obtaining this result requires training a separate generator for every candidate schedule.
blocks.zh: 表3报告了主要结果并涉及两个不同的比较。 我们的主要比较是采用先前几步法采用的统一盘式。 这是从业者在没有培训多个特定时间表的发电机的情况下选择合理时间表的标准设定。 我们还报告我们盘状搜索的最佳结果,作为神谕式的比较。 在自我推出的设定中,要获得这一结果,就需要为每个候选人时间表培训一个单独的发电机。

blocks.en: Under the standard uniform discretization, data-space iteration consistently outperforms both flow-renoise and flow-map across all reported NFE settings. Even when allowing an oracle selection of the best of three discretizations, flow-map only narrows the gap and remains slightly behind, while flow-renoise continues to lag substantially. Thus, data-space iteration achieves stronger performance without schedule search or schedule-specific training. Additional metrics are provided in the appendix.
blocks.zh: 在标准的统一光碟化下,数据空间迭接在所有报告的NFE设置中都始终优于流出和流出图. 即使允许甲骨文选取三个盘状物中最好的,流相图也只会缩小差距并保持略为落后,而流相图则会继续大幅滞后. 因此,数据空间迭接在没有时间表搜索或时间表特定培训的情况下,能实现更强的性能. 附录中提供了其他衡量标准。

blocks.en: Interestingly, in the unguided setting, all DMD-distilled models substantially outperform the flow-matching teacher. We hypothesize that this improvement arises from the mode-seeking behavior of the reverse-KL objective used by DMD, as discussed in prior research ( Karras et al., 2024 ; Zheng et al., 2025 ; Lin et al., 2026b ) .

blocks.en: 4 Related Work
blocks.zh: 4 相关工作

blocks.en: ODE-based distillation methods compress the flow trajectory by matching teacher transitions, velocities, or consistency targets ( Salimans and Ho, 2022 ; Geng et al., 2025 ; Frans et al., 2025 ; Song et al., 2023 ) . However, pointwise regression objectives often produce blurry samples. Recent work shows that distribution-level objectives can substantially improve such distilled generators ( Lin et al., 2025a ; Zheng et al., 2026b ) . Distribution matching distillation (DMD) ( Yin et al., 2024b ; Yin et al., 2024a ) , building on variational score-distillation ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Luo et al., 2023b ) , has become a widely adopted approach. Orthogonal work improves the scaling, parameterization, and score estimation of DMD ( Ge et al., 2026 ; Cheng et al., 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2025 ) ; these advances are complementary to our focus on the generator’s iteration space.
blocks.zh: 基于ODE的蒸馏方法通过匹配教师过渡,速度,或一致性目标来压缩流出轨迹(Salimans and Ho, 2022;Geng等人, 2025;Frans等人, 2025; Song等人, 2023). 然而,指向回归目标往往产生模糊的样本. 最近的工作表明,分配一级的目标可以大大改进这种蒸馏发电机(Lin等人,2025a; Zheng等, 2026b.). 分布相配蒸馏(DMD)(Yin等, 2024b.; Yin等,2024a.),以可变分数-分馏法(Wang等,2023;Luo等,2023b.)为基础,已经成为一种被广泛采用的方法. Orthogonal工作改进了DMD的缩放,参数化,分数估计(Ge等,2026;Cheng等,2026;Zhou等,2025;Chen等,2026;Lu等,2025;这些进展补充了我们关注发电机的重置空间.

blocks.en: Prior work has optimized inference-time discretizations for flow models, but uses a single schedule shared across samples ( Xue et al., 2024 ; Park et al., 2025 ) . Recent methods instead train a separate predictor, conditioned on the same input as the flow model, to produce sample-specific discretizations ( Tong et al., 2025 ; Yuan et al., 2026 ) . This approach is not directly compatible with self-rollout distillation, where the timestep schedule must be specified during distillation training.
blocks.zh: 先前的工作已经优化了流出模型的推论-时间盘点,但采用了在样本之间共享的单一时间表(薛等,2024;朴等,2025. 最近的方法是训练一个单独的预测器,以与流量模型相同的输入为条件,以产生特定样本的磁盘(Tong等,2025;Yuan等,2026)。 这种方法与自滚蒸馏不直接相容,在蒸馏训练中必须规定时间步表.

blocks.en: The closest connection to our method is self-conditioning ( Chen et al., 2023 ; Strudel et al., 2022 ; Dieleman et al., 2022 ) . Existing self-conditioning methods use predictions from previous evaluations to refine the model’s velocity field, while generation still proceeds by integrating that field along an ODE. Our method instead treats the data prediction itself as the iterative state, so the data-space refinements directly constitute the few-step generation process.
blocks.zh: 与我们的方法最接近的是自修(Chen等,2023;Strudel等,2022;Dieleman等,2022.). 现有的自我调节方法利用以前评价的预测来完善模型的速度场,而代代仍然通过将该场与ODE结合而进行。 我们的方法将数据预测本身视为迭代状态,因此数据空间的完善直接构成了几步生成过程.

blocks.en: Our formulation also resembles deep equilibrium models; Section 2.6 details the key conceptual differences. Recent work applies this paradigm to generative distillation ( Geng et al., 2023 ) , solving for a fixed point in an internal hidden representation before decoding it into an image. This approach requires an equilibrium-specific architecture and solver. In contrast, our method requires minimal architectural changes and is therefore more suitable for distilling existing pretrained generative models.
blocks.zh: 我们的表述也类似于深度平衡模式;第2.6节详细介绍了关键的概念差异。 最近的工作将这个范式应用于基因分馏(Geng等,2023年),在内部隐藏的表示中为固定点解析后再解码成图像. 这种方法需要一种针对均衡的架构和解决器. 相形之下,我们的方法需要最小的建筑改变,因此更适合蒸馏现有的被预先训练的基因模型.

blocks.en: Looped transformers scale effective depth by repeatedly applying shared transformer blocks ( Jeddi et al., 2026 ; Goyal et al., 2026 ) . Recent work has explored this idea for generative modeling by training a looped transformer end to end with a distribution-matching objective ( Lin et al., 2026a ) . However, this approach backpropagates through the full unrolled loop. The resulting computational and memory costs during training can be a hurdle in practice. Data-space iteration is instead a lightweight, drop-in modification to existing distillation training pipelines.
blocks.zh: 循环变压器通过反复应用共享变压器块来缩放有效深度(Jeddi等,2026;Goyal等,2026.). 最近的工作探索了这种基因模型的构思,培训一个循环式变压器端端以分配相配的目标结束(Lin等人,2026a.). 然而,这种方法通过全无滚动循环反射. 培训期间产生的计算和内存费用在实践中可能是一个障碍。 数据空间迭接是对现有蒸馏培训管道的一种轻量级的即时修改。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduced data-space iteration for few-step generation. By directly refining data predictions, our method removes the need for a fixed flow-time discretization and integrates into DMD with minimal changes. On class-conditional ImageNet 256 × 256 256\times 256 , it outperforms standard uniform-discretization baselines and matches or improves upon schedule-searched variants without requiring schedule-specific training. These results demonstrate that data-space refinement is a simple and effective approach to fast generation.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了数据空间迭代 几步生成。 通过直接完善数据预测,我们的方法消除了固定流时盘式化的需要,并用最小的改变整合入DMD. 在班级条件ImageNet 256×256 256\times 256上,它超越了标准的统一分解基线,在按时间表搜索的变体上匹配或改进,而不需要具体按时间表进行训练. 这些结果表明,完善数据空间是快速生成的一种简单而有效的方法。

blocks.en: Data-space iteration requires self-rollout training. This incurs no additional cost when self-rollout is already required but is a disadvantage otherwise. If ODE-based distillation objectives are preferred over distributional objectives, data-space iteration can be trained with paired data and noise samples, but more efficient training approaches remain to be explored.
blocks.zh: 数据空间迭接需要自我推出培训. 如果已经需要自行推出,则不产生额外费用,否则是一种不利因素。 如果基于ODE的蒸馏目标比分布目标更受青睐,则数据空间迭接可以通过对接数据和噪声样本来进行训练,但更有效的培训方法仍有待探索.

blocks.en: Following prior few-step generation research, we focus on ImageNet 256 × 256 256\times 256 generation for the main paper. We additionally provide CIFAR-10 results on a UNet architecture in the appendix. We provide the details of hyperparameters, architectures, and code in the appendix. Scaling data-space iteration to text-to-image generation and other modalities is left for future work.
blocks.zh: 继之前的几步生成研究之后,我们专注于ImageNet 256×256256\times 256生成主论文. 我们还在附录中提供CIFAR-10关于UNet架构的结果。 我们在附录中提供了超参数、结构和代码的细节。 将数据空间迭代扩大为文本到图像生成和其他模式留待今后工作。

blocks.en: Algorithm 1 gives the core PyTorch implementation. The two rollout functions expose the only difference between data-space iteration and flow-renoise iteration; dmd_step implements their shared DMD objective. The sampled index r ∈ { 0 , … , R − 1 } r\in\{0,\ldots,R-1\} identifies the refinement step being optimized: steps 0 , … , r − 1 0,\ldots,r-1 are evaluated without gradient tracking, followed by the gradient-tracked step r r that produces x ^ 0 ( r + 1 ) \hat{x}_{0}^{(r+1)} .
